title: 5-5-3两角和与差的正弦、余弦、正切公式
source_file: 云端习题/函数习题/5-5-3两角和与差的正弦、余弦、正切公式.md

analysis.核心考点: 利用正弦差角公式确定角的关系，再通过角的范围限制和辅助角公式求三角函数的最值
analysis.解题思路: 由已知条件得sin(α-β)=1，结合α,β∈[0,π]推出α-β=π/2，进而用β表示α；将目标式化简为cosα+cosβ，代入α=β+π/2得cosβ-sinβ，利用辅助角公式化为√2cos(β+π/4)；根据β的范围求该式的取值范围，得到最大值1和最小值-1

original_resource.题干: (2024年合肥模拟)设$\alpha$，$\beta\in[0, \pi]$，且满足$\sin \alpha \cos \beta - \cos \alpha \sin \beta = 1$，则$\sin (2\alpha - \beta) + \sin (\alpha - 2\beta)$的最大值为\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_，最小值为\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_．
original_resource.知识点标签: 正弦差角;三角函数最值
original_resource.解析: 答案：$1$；$-1$   解析：由$\sin \alpha \cos \beta - \cos \alpha \sin \beta = 1$，得$\sin(\alpha - \beta) = 1$．   又$\alpha, \beta \in [0, \pi]$，∴$-\pi \leq \alpha - \beta \leq \pi$，   ∴$\alpha - \beta = \dfrac{\pi}{2}$．   于是$\alpha = \beta + \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，结合$\beta \in [0, \pi]$且$\alpha \in [0, \pi]$，得$\beta \in \left[0, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$，$\alpha \in \left[\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]$．    计算：   $$ \sin(2\alpha - \beta) + \sin(\alpha - 2\beta)  = \sin\left(\alpha + (\alpha - \beta)\right) + \sin\left((\alpha - \beta) - \beta\right)  = \sin\left(\alpha + \frac{\pi}{2}\right) + \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \beta\right) = \cos \alpha + \cos \beta. $$  但由$\alpha = \beta + \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，有$\cos \alpha = \cos\left(\beta + \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = -\sin \beta$，   故   $$ \cos \alpha + \cos \beta = -\sin \beta + \cos \beta = \sqrt{2}\cos\left(\beta + \frac{\pi}{4}\right). $$  由于$\beta \in \left[0, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$，则$\beta + \dfrac{\pi}{4} \in \left[\dfrac{\pi}{4}, \dfrac{3\pi}{4}\right]$，   ∴$\cos\left(\beta + \dfrac{\pi}{4}\right) \in \left[-\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}, \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right]$，   ∴$\sqrt{2}\cos\left(\beta + \dfrac{\pi}{4}\right) \in [-1, 1]$．    或更简洁地（按原推导修正符号与逻辑）：   由$\alpha - \beta = \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，得   $$ \sin(2\alpha - \beta) + \sin(\alpha - 2\beta)  = \sin\left(\alpha + \frac{\pi}{2}\right) + \sin\left(\alpha - 2\beta\right). $$   而$\alpha - 2\beta = (\alpha - \beta) - \beta = \dfrac{\pi}{2} - \beta$，   所以   $$ \sin\left(\alpha + \frac{\pi}{2}\right) + \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \beta\right)  = \cos \alpha + \cos \beta. $$   再代入$\alpha = \beta + \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，得$\cos \alpha = -\sin \beta$，   故表达式为$\cos \beta - \sin \beta = \sqrt{2}\cos\left(\beta + \dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)$，   值域仍为$[-1, 1]$．    综上，$\sin(2\alpha - \beta) + \sin(\alpha - 2\beta)$ 的取值范围为 $[-1,\, 1]$，最大值为 $1$，最小值为 $-1$．
